name: Bend Molding and Prototype
old_description: We deliver the invaluable "talk to the machinist" experience that is often absent in today's rapid tooling market. When you engage our services, it's akin to having a seasoned tooling expert by your side.
about:
Bend Molding and Prototype operates from Bend, Oregon. The company was founded by mechanical engineers and draws on over 30 years of mechanical engineering experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The shop specializes in fast-turn injection molding, handling projects from CAD design through prototype to full-scale production. All services are performed in-house and include design for manufacturing (DFM), precision mold manufacturing, injection molding, and detailed quality reporting. The engineering team also provides prototype design, mechanical design, and product development support.

The company serves customers who need plastic components across a range of applications, offering a single point of contact from initial design consultation to final part delivery. Clients include those requiring rapid prototypes as well as production volumes, though specific industries are not listed.

Bend Molding and Prototype emphasizes direct communication, giving clients access to engineers and toolmakers throughout the project. The team aims to deliver most prototype components within three to five weeks from DFM consultation to first samples, positioning itself as a domestic supplier that prioritizes collaboration and speed.
